(435)༄༅/bla bslu'i las 'grigs bzhugs so/thog mar/da nangs snga mor dkar gtor bgegs gtor gtang*/rig 'dzin 'dus pa 'daun/rtsa bsnyen brgya/las bsnyen lnga

tei:div.tei:p: thog mar/ da nangs snga mor dkar gtor bgegs gtor gtang*/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa 'daun/ rtsa bsnyen brgya/ las bsnyen lnga bcu/ mchod bstod sogs bya'o/ de nas yum ka'i las byang gzhung bzhin bstod pa bcas btaun nas/ kun tu bzang mo'i klong du dag gyur cigaḥ bar ro/ yig brgya tshar gcig 'phros/ 'chi bslu las/ mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar pad zla'i stengaḥ sogs/ bskrad par dmigasaḥ oṃ pad+mo= sogs/ nṛḥdzaḥswa hāḥ zhes ci nus bzlas nas mchod bstod rgyas par bya'o/ de nas mdos rdzas rnams sngags drug phyag drug re re nas bdun bdun gyis brlabs nas/ kyeḥ sangs rgyas rkang gnyis= sogs nas/ ril bu la sogs pa'i yas kyang gsol/ bka' nan gsolaḥ bar/ phyi rol du gser skyems mchod/ bla 'gugs ngar mi re bzhin stong phrag re song nas/ de nas glud gcig chang bu gcig ril bu gcig bcas bshams/ 'bru gsum dang*/ saṃ bha ra= tshar gcig gis brlabs nas/ khyer cig khyer cig= sogs/ nyid ma: bar/ mi re re bzhin lan brgya dang brgyad tshar sogs song*/ de nas tshogs 'don/ lhag ma bcas tshar nas/ phyi chog la mkha' 'gro'i las byang 'don/ sngar ltar glud brgya rtsa bcas song nas gsol ka dang chad brtan bya'o// (436) bla bslu'i gtor ma bca' lugs ni/ spar kha brgyad la glud brgyad/ rgyal chen bzhi yi gtor ma/ yul 'khor srung la gtor zlum dkar po gcig 'phags skyes po la gtor sngon gru gsum can gcig mig mi bzang la gtor ma zla gam dmar po gcig rnam thos sras la gtor ma gru bzhi ser po gcig shar gdon dbang po rdo rje la gtor zlum dkar po gcig lho gdon gshin rje la gtor sngon zlum po gcig nub gdon dbang ldan la gtor zlum dmar po gcig byang gdon gnod sbyin la gtor zlum ser po gcig shar lho'i gdon me lha la gtor zlum dkar sngon 'dres pa gcig lho nub gdon srin po la gtor zlum dmar sngon 'dres pa gcig

nub byang rlung lha'i gdon la gtor zlum ser dmar 'dres pa gcig byang shar dbang ldan la gtor zlum dkar ser 'dres pa gcig chang bu gcig sbyin bdag glud skye mched dod pa/ mar lug mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma sogs/ bka' srung gtor ma bcas mthong ba brgyud pa ltar ro/ mda' dar/ shing ris sna tshogs mda' 'phang rgyang bu bcas ci mang bya'o// dge'o//
